boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of Portland, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key, under-21-safe first-weekend sequence centered on named University of Portland campus destinations and recurring campus activities.

cards.entity_name: Bell Tower, Marian Garden and Grotto
cards.title: Start with the campus landmark
cards.subtitle: First stop: Bell Tower Plaza
cards.notes: Meet your group at the Bell Tower Plaza, then use the Marian Garden and Grotto as landmarks while you orient yourself to the academic core.
cards.short_summary: A clear first meeting point beside UP’s Bell Tower.
cards.evidence_claim: UP’s campus map lists the Bell Tower, Marian Garden and Grotto, and the university archive identifies the Bell Tower as the campus’s tallest structure.
cards.access_notes: Use the interactive campus map to confirm routes and accessibility before visiting.

cards.title: Pause for a meal and a plan
cards.subtitle: Friday: Bauccio Commons
cards.notes: Choose a meal break at Bauccio Commons, then make a loose plan for the rest of the weekend over the building’s dining and study spaces.
cards.short_summary: Campus dining and gathering space in one stop.
cards.evidence_claim: UP describes Bauccio Commons as a place for dining, meetings, study, conversations, and patio time.
cards.source_title: Bauccio Commons | University of Portland Calendar
cards.access_notes: Food and some dining access require a meal plan or purchase; check current dining arrangements before going.

cards.title: Find a dependable study base
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon: Clark Library
cards.notes: Walk through Clark Library and pick out a quiet seat or reservable space you can return to once classes begin; bring your campus credentials.
cards.short_summary: A practical orientation stop for future study sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: UP says Clark Library offers seating, outlets, staff help, group study rooms, booths, and individual study carrels.
cards.source_title: Best Places to Study on Campus | University of Portland
cards.access_notes: Library services and room reservations may have current eligibility rules; verify them with the library.

cards.title: Take an active-campus break
cards.subtitle: Friday: Beauchamp Recreation & Wellness Center
cards.notes: Tour the Beauchamp Recreation & Wellness Center and decide whether a casual workout, indoor track walk, or group class fits your weekend energy.
cards.short_summary: A recreation stop with courts, track, and exercise facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: UP describes Beauchamp as a two-story recreation facility with cardio equipment, weights, three basketball courts, an indoor track, and exercise studios.
cards.source_title: University of Portland International Student Guide
cards.access_notes: Confirm current recreation-center entry requirements and equipment policies before participating.

cards.title: Use the student-center pause
cards.subtitle: Friday evening: Pilot House
cards.notes: Regroup in the Pilot House for a snack or coffee, then check whether campus programming is scheduled in its live-entertainment space that evening.
cards.short_summary: A student-center stop for food, seating, and possible programming.
cards.evidence_claim: UP identifies the Pilot House as home to a grill, small market, comfortable seating, pub, and stage for live entertainment.
cards.source_title: University of Portland International Student Guide
cards.access_notes: Food and beverages are purchased; select under-21-safe options and check the university calendar for event details.

cards.title: Settle into a social lounge
cards.subtitle: Friday night: St. Mary’s Student Center
cards.notes: Stop by St. Mary’s Student Center to see its lounge setting and meet up with peers for a relaxed conversation before heading back to residence halls.
cards.short_summary: A casual campus lounge stop for getting acquainted.
cards.evidence_claim: UP describes the St. Mary’s lounge as a campus hangout space where activities are usually taking place.
cards.source_title: Best Places to Study on Campus | University of Portland
cards.access_notes: Activities and building access vary; follow posted residence-life and event guidance.

cards.title: Make space for a quiet reset
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning: Chapel of Christ the Teacher
cards.notes: Visit the Chapel of Christ the Teacher for a quiet moment, or check Campus Ministry’s current schedule if you want to attend a worship service.
cards.short_summary: A reflective stop at the center of campus ministry.
cards.evidence_claim: UP identifies the Chapel of Christ the Teacher as the principal center of campus ministry activity and says it is available for prayer and meditation to university community members.
cards.access_notes: Worship times and building availability can change; confirm the current Campus Ministry schedule.

cards.title: Walk the academic quadrangle
cards.subtitle: Saturday: Franz Hall
cards.notes: Use Franz Hall as one point in a short academic-core walk, then notice how its entrance aligns with the Chapel across the quadrangle.
cards.short_summary: An architectural waypoint linking academic and chapel spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: UP’s digital collections state that Franz Hall forms the north end of an academic quadrangle and is aligned with the Chapel of Christ the Teacher.
cards.source_title: Franz Hall | University of Portland Clark Library Digital Collections
cards.access_notes: Treat this as an exterior-oriented walk unless you have authorized building access.

cards.title: Check the weekend athletics calendar
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon: Chiles Center
cards.notes: Look for a current Pilots home event at the Chiles Center, and make it a group outing only if the schedule, ticketing, and entry details work.
cards.short_summary: A possible event stop at UP’s athletics venue.
cards.evidence_claim: UP identifies Chiles Center as the home of its Division I athletics programs competing in the West Coast Conference.
cards.source_title: Chiles Center athletics announcement | University of Portland
cards.access_notes: Events are schedule-dependent and may require tickets; verify the current athletics calendar and venue policies.

cards.entity_name: University of Portland Interactive Campus Map
cards.title: Close with a self-guided map walk
cards.subtitle: Sunday: connect the stops on foot
cards.notes: Open UP’s interactive campus map and take a daylight walk between the destinations you used, noting entrances and routes you’ll want for Monday.
cards.short_summary: A simple way to turn the weekend’s stops into a usable campus route.
cards.evidence_claim: UP directs visitors, students, faculty, and staff to its interactive campus map for detailed campus information and resources.
cards.source_title: New Updated Campus Maps | University of Portland
cards.access_notes: Stay on public campus paths and consult the map for current route, accessibility, and building information.
